title: Rescuers search for survivors of powerful Indonesia earthquake
description: Officials say a rapid assessment into the impact of the earthquake that destroyed hundreds of buildings and killed 47 is under way.

title: Reform proposes £50bn welfare bill cut with changes to disability payments for millions
description: The party's proposed changes were they to come to power include a replacement for the disability payments system Pip.

title: Hurricane Lala lashes Hawaii with strong winds and torrential rain
description: If the storm makes landfall, it will be Hawaii's first direct hit by a hurricane in 34 years.
